## Design note

The highway-patrol hammer, sent when nothing else can keep up: the muscle coupe's V8 and big brakes on performance tires, with a push bar on the nose. It runs with the modern sports cars to pursuit speed and brakes later than any other unit, but two doors, a heavy nose and rear drive make it a handful in the wet and useless for boxing in a truck.

## How this car breaks

Modern UHSS coupe cell with long crumple rails, plus a reinforced push bar and doubled bumper beam: it survives PIT contact and nose shunts well. The long coupe doors and low sills are its weak spots in side hits, and the cooling pack behind the bar goes once the bar is gone.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

## Engine

5.0 L DOHC 32-valve V8, naturally aspirated, pursuit calibration (extra oil and transmission coolers). Same class engine as the Rampart 5.0 (2010s NA 5.0 DOHC V8, ~64 kW/L); the pursuit package changes cooling, not output.

## Drivetrain

6-speed automatic with torque converter (pursuit packages are automatic-only), clutch-type rear LSD. Layout **RWD**; front diff: open; rear diff: clutch LSD, preload 60 N·m, power ramp 0.50, coast ramp 0.35. Torque converter: stall 2400 rpm, 1.9× at stall, couples 1:1 from 2800 rpm (class-typical for the gearbox). Clutch capacity 1.60 × peak torque = 850 N·m. Shift time 0.25 s.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.30 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 470 kg | 1.65 Hz | 50600 N/m | 2930 N·s/m | 4400 N·s/m | 0.15 m |
| Rear | 379 kg | 1.75 Hz | 45800 N/m | 2500 N·s/m | 3750 N·s/m | 0.16 m |

Round 12b ride rule (A): the file carries the derived dampers × 1.2 bump / × 1.6 rebound (rebound ≈ 2 × bump), after any tunes below: **3520 / 7040 N·s/m F, 3000 / 6000 N·s/m R** (bump / rebound).

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 2.6°/g with 60% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.412 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 161447 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 63118 F / 62350 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **13500 F / 800 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 2.6°/g, front share 60%. Bump stops 180000 N/m.

Alignment: camber -1.0° F / -1.0° R, toe +0.00° F / +0.20° R (+ = in), caster 7.0°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 100 bar.

- Front: 380 mm disc, pistons per side 46 mm + 40 mm + 36 mm → A = 39.4 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 165 mm, pad μ = 0.42: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.42·100 bar·39.4 cm²·0.165 m = **5456 N·m**
- Rear: 330 mm disc, pistons per side 45 mm → A = 15.9 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 140 mm, pad μ = 0.4: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.4·100 bar·15.9 cm²·0.140 m = **1781 N·m**

ABS ceiling: caliper capacity 5456 / 1781 N·m exceeds 1.5 × the front lock torque on this car's tire (peak μ 1.20), which `wp_vehicle`'s ABS cannot modulate (it releases to a fraction of the commanded torque, so an oversized caliper keeps the wheel locked). Both axles scaled by 0.76 → **4160 / 1360 N·m**. Remove when 02's ABS modulates relative to lock torque.

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 2309 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.80×), rear needs 830 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.64×).

`wp_vehicle` gives the axle `bias_front` favours its full `max_torque_*` and scales the other by (1 − b)/b, so `max_torque_*` holds the caliper capacity per wheel and `bias_front` acts as the proportioning valve: the rear is trimmed to the same lock margin as the front (ideal rear = T_f · lock_r/lock_f = 1496 N·m), never boosted above its caliper capacity. Rear capacity is below that (hardware-limited rear), so `bias_front` = **0.5**: both axles get full caliper torque → delivered 4160 N·m front / 1360 N·m rear per wheel at full pedal. Handbrake 2120 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 15.7:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 10.4 m → outer-front path radius 5.06 m, rear-axle-centre radius 3.46 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.671 rad (38.5°)** (outer 32.9°, inner 45.8° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.60). Rack speed 1.4 rad/s.
